sentences.en: Every seven years we let the land lie fallow.
sentences.zh: 每隔七年我们让土地休耕一次。

sentences.en: That fallow paddy field does not yield anymore.
sentences.zh: 那块休闲的稻田已经不再产粮了。

sentences.en: We use some fields for fallow during rotation to improve soil quality.
sentences.zh: 我们在轮作过程中用一些田地休耕以改善土壤质量。
